scope: Maison Ameco only. Public source research and local evidence review. No PDE calls, Git, registry/repository edits, user contact, image import, or mutation.

conclusion.identity: Confirmed: existing Maison Ameco is a covered indoor exploration/play structure, listed by its own name on the official current catalogue and 2026 brochure, not Kids Land or Aquabully.
conclusion.restriction: Unresolved official-source contradiction; no definitive min/max age, height limit or accompanying-adult condition newly established.
conclusion.chronology: The under-five recommendation comes from a dated 2025 article still online, whereas the current catalogue is undated. There is no evidence of the effective date or direction of any change.
conclusion.recommendedHandling: Do not certify or publish a replacement age, reinterpret minimum as maximum, or infer age from photographed children. Preserve the contradiction and existing evidence for editorial review. The existing private MinAge10/High condition has a direct official quotation, but its certainty is undermined by the conflicting official article.

importantDistinctions: The separate sentence « Réservé aux enfants de moins de5ans » on Exploration belongs to Aquabully, not Maison Ameco. Search snippets can juxtapose these records misleadingly. The real under-five contradiction is the separate Printemps article.
The brochure marker10 does not validate an age restriction. The catalogue literally says minimum10 independently, so no claim of a proven data-entry mix-up is made.
Official catalogue presence supports named inclusion in the current offer, not an invented first-open date. No inferred reopening or closure.
The two official catalogue views can share one content source; counting them twice does not resolve contradiction.
An older article still online is not proof the current catalogue changed later. No dated change notice found.
